تستأصلي (form X)

# تُسْتَأْصَلِي (tustaʔṣalī) /tus.taʔ.sˤa.liː/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَأْصَلَ (istaʔṣala)
